QR labels

Print once, cut along the dashed lines and slide each label into the spine pocket behind the paper title. The code only carries the binder number, so you never reprint after changing anything.

Medium reads from about a metre, small from 70 cm. Matte paper keeps the pocket glare down.

Binders

Names, contents and filing schedule for every binder. Changes stay on this device until you export them.

The left cabinet and the top-left shelf were read from a photo — check their names. Schedule means how often a record must go into the binder; expiry is for certificate binders.
